svg.title: Nested SVG image containing a data URL PNG
svg.desc: Data URLs are exempt from external-resource restrictions in secure processing modes. SVG 2 sections 2.2.1 and 2.5.5 require this nested image to retain all 64 opaque red pixels. https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/single-page.html#conform-features https://svgwg.org/svg2-draft/single-page.html#conform-ConformingSVGViewers
